title: Axonometric Pop
description: Un style d'illustration numérique contemporain fusionnant des contours nets et uniformes en ligne claire avec une perspective aplatie en plongée. Il se caractérise par des aplats de couleurs pastel rehaussés d'une texture de grain pointillée et d'ombres portées nettes aux tons froids.
description_en: A contemporary digital illustration style merging clean, uniform ligne-claire outlines with a flattened, high-angle perspective. It features high-key pastel color blocking enhanced by a distinct stippled grain texture and sharp, cool-toned cast shadows.
description_fr: Un style d'illustration numérique contemporain fusionnant des contours nets et uniformes en ligne claire avec une perspective aplatie en plongée. Il se caractérise par des aplats de couleurs pastel rehaussés d'une texture de grain pointillée et d'ombres portées nettes aux tons froids.
prompt: Digital illustration in a contemporary ligne-claire and isometric architectural style. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The artwork must occupy the absolute entire dedicated space as a canvas rule: no borders, no frames, no white margins, no canvas edges, full bleed to all four corners. The rendering technique relies on clean, uniform, thin dark contour lines defining every geometric edge, structural detail, and organic form with absolute precision. Fill these outlined shapes with a high-key pastel color palette dominated by {{primary_color}}, balanced with {{accent_color}} and {{secondary_color}}. The lighting anatomy features strong, directional sunlight creating sharp, distinct, geometric cast shadows. Instead of deep blacks, these shadows are rendered as flat, cool-toned color blocks that maintain the structural clarity of the scene. Apply a distinct, uniform digital stipple or risograph-style noise texture across all flat color fills, giving the pristine vector-like linework a subtly tactile, printed materiality. The spatial dynamics utilize a flattened, high-angle axonometric or forced perspective, compressing depth while maintaining rigorous geometric proportions. Edges are razor-sharp, defined entirely by the uniform inking without any soft gradients or feathered transitions. The atmosphere is serene, structured, and airy, combining technical drafting precision with a soft, playful color science. video.motion: Elements translate linearly with rigid, mechanical precision; moving parts slide or scale uniformly without organic deformation.
video.camera: A locked high-angle isometric perspective or a slow, perfectly linear diagonal pan across the scene.
video.temporal_texture: The stippled grain texture must boil rapidly at a low frame rate while the thin contour lines remain absolutely rigid and fixed.
video.avoid: Avoid motion blur, 3D camera rotations, soft shadow transitions, or fluid organic deformations.
